integrity: The proof reconstructs the exact random input law, an independent deficit reduction, density envelopes, Dirichlet comparison and uniform integrability. Verification code supports finite cases only. Originality is assessed against the accessible primary paper and targeted related searches, with residual risk of a differently expressed classical asymptotic.
scientific_limitations: Sharp relative asymptotic for omitting exactly one preassigned map, with row-normalized independent uniform inputs. The finite-dimensional polytope criterion is elementary; the high-dimensional probability and its 1/2 exponential correction are the main result. No claim of a multi-map solution, alternative row law, explicit remainder, or independent certification.
title: Sharp exclusion probability for one forbidden grand-coupling map
